title: Readiness
description: Catalog row readiness 1.0.0 (ADR-0080 decision 4): what is real in this build, per catalog row except readiness itself, written by data-pipeline/pipeline/core/readiness.py to data/derived/readiness.json from docs/contracts/catalog.md and the repository state, and read by the frontend and the dormant API. Deterministic: the product version and the catalog's SHA-256 identify it, no wall-clock time. The states and what each surface does with them: docs/contracts/catalog.md, section Missing-data states.

catalog_sha256.description: SHA-256 of docs/contracts/catalog.md (its UTF-8 bytes with CRLF normalised to LF) the document was computed from.

status.description: The catalog's design status: real once the real producer serves the row, active while its provider does.

provenance.description: What actually served the row in this build; null when nothing did (state missing).

reason.description: Why the state is not available; null only when it is.

missing.description: For partial: what is absent (file paths, rejected record ids). Empty otherwise.

state.description: available: the real producer answered. partial: some of it exists (missing lists the rest). stale: an older bake answered (reason says how old). provider: the row's provider answered (provenance says which kind). training: a model slot answered with the released model or the baseline while a newer model trains, or with the baseline while no released model exists. missing: nothing answered.

text.description: Every reader-facing string is bilingual at the source.
